suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Therapy session (2 hours)
suggested_services.example: The main story: therapy sessions billed to the plan; nothing taken when booking; the family's copays come in one bill a month. The free intake call also runs here, with nothing to pay.

suggested_services.name: Therapy session (2 hours)
suggested_services.example: A self-pay family: a card is saved when booking, and that week's sessions are charged to it once a week. Nothing is charged for a late cancel.

suggested_services.name: In-home therapy session (2 hours)
suggested_services.example: The main story: in-home sessions billed to the plan; nothing taken, and the copays come in one monthly bill.

suggested_services.name: In-home therapy session (2 hours)
suggested_services.example: A self-pay family at home: the saved card is charged once a week for that week's sessions.

suggested_services.name: In-home therapy session (2 hours)

before_times: has the child been diagnosed (most plans need the diagnosis report)
where therapy would happen: at the center, at home, or at school or daycare
how many hours a week the family hopes for, and which days and times work
a health plan, self-pay or a public program (only the name here)
after_time: for home sessions: the address, who will be home, and pets
for school sessions: the school's name (the school's OK comes through the family)
secure_page_only: the diagnosis report and the doctor's referral the plan needs
the child's health: allergies, seizures, medicines, toileting, sensory needs, and how the child communicates
behavior safety: running off, self-injury, aggression, what calms the child, and the crisis plan
consents, each a separate yes: treatment, the privacy notice, any restraint in the plan, photos or video for supervision
the approved pick-up list (adults with photo ID)
custody papers where parents are separated and one may not consent or pick up
releases to share with the school, the doctor or another therapist, each named
intake_questions.who_may_book: a parent or legal guardian books for the child and consents; where parents are separated, the papers on the secure page decide who may book, consent and pick up; a school or daycare never books, but gives its written OK for sessions there; an adult with autism books for themselves or with their guardian

stop.words: a child is missing (ran off from the center or a home session), a seizure over 5 minutes, trouble breathing, or a serious injury
stop.say: This sounds like an emergency. If anyone is in danger, get to safety and call 911 now.
stop.booking: no booking; the parent is called at once

stop.words: suicide or self-harm words from a parent, a teen, or the child
stop.say: If you're thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 now. If you're in danger right now, call 911.
stop.booking: 988 and 911 first, at once, any hour; no booking in that chat until a clear 'I'm safe right now'; the analyst is told the same day

go_on.words: self-injury or aggression that's getting worse
go_on.what: the analyst is told privately the same day; a safety review before the next session

go_on.words: a report of abuse or neglect of a child
go_on.what: the practice's staff report as the law requires; Rosie gives the state's child abuse hotline from its safety list and tells a person on Rosie's team the same day; never asks for details by text

go_on.words: asks about medicines or a diagnosis
go_on.what: never answered by Rosie: the analyst or the child's doctor

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → 911, and no booking; a child's details are never asked by text

steps.name: Free intake call
steps.result: the family knows the papers and the plan's steps

steps.name: Diagnosis report and the doctor's referral
steps.when: on file before the assessment, by the due date
steps.who: the family uploads them, or the doctor's office sends them
steps.result: on file: the plan's approval is asked for; missing: the assessment waits

steps.name: The plan's approval
steps.when: the practice asks for it for the assessment, then for the therapy hours (it can take 2 to 4 weeks); renewed every 6 months
steps.result: approved hours a week and an end date: sessions are booked only inside them; denied: self-pay or no therapy

steps.name: Initial assessment
steps.result: the treatment plan and the hours asked for

steps.name: Treatment plan signed by the parent
Consents and the pick-up list
steps.when: on the secure page before the first session
steps.result: done: sessions go on; not done by the due date: one reminder, then the owner decides

steps.name: School's written OK
steps.when: before any session at school or daycare
steps.result: no OK: sessions stay at the center or home

steps.name: Reassessment and renewal
steps.result: renewed: the schedule goes on; not renewed by the end date: sessions stop or turn self-pay, with the parent's yes

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: the child's snack and water, a change of clothes, any toys or rewards the analyst asked for, and any communication device; for home sessions, a quiet space and an adult at home

staff.skills: behavior analyst, behavior technician, trained on a given child's plan (per child), parent training, social skills groups, home sessions, school sessions, toddlers, Spanish, sign language
staff.licenses_or_certificates: analysts certified (and licensed where the state requires); technicians registered and supervised
staff.supervision: each technician has a named supervising analyst who supervises at the share the board and the plan require (the analyst joins sessions)
staff.who_oks: the analyst OKs plan changes, a new technician on a child's team, and a return after an incident; the owner OKs schedule changes and fees
staff.stand_in: only a technician already trained on this child's plan (on the child's team), and the parent is told before the session; nobody new is sent to a child without the parent's yes; nobody on the team free: the session is cancelled with no fee
staff.ratio: one technician per child in therapy sessions; one staff for every 3 children in groups

children_and_age.who_may_book: a parent or legal guardian books for the child and consents; where parents are separated, the papers on the secure page decide who may book, consent and pick up; a school or daycare never books, but gives its written OK for sessions there; an adult with autism books for themselves or with their guardian
children_and_age.minors_texts: every text goes to the parent or guardian; separated parents each get texts only as the custody papers allow

visit.check_in: at the center: the parent gives the check-in code at the desk and signs the child in; pick-up only by an adult on the approved list, with photo ID; at home: the code at the door and a parent or caregiver stays home; at school: the school's own sign-in, then the code
visit.done: the code at drop-off, then DONE from the technician once the session note is done in the practice's own records; session data and progress reports stay in the practice's records; the parent gets a short daily note on the secure page; Rosie keeps only booking records
visit.changes_at_visit: the analyst updates the treatment plan and the hours: a change in hours is a new schedule the parent OKs, and the plan's approval may be needed first; nothing is sold at a session

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: the practice's own word, optional: each behavior analyst's national certification and any state license the practice names; each behavior technician's own registration; the practice's own license if it has one. Rosie never looks a license up and never says one is checked
license.who: both: the practice and each analyst and technician
license.ask: each analyst's certification and state license numbers; each technician's registration number and their supervising analyst; the practice's license where one exists
license.insurance: professional liability insurance where the state's form or the health plan asks for it
license.background: a background check for everyone who works with children is the practice's own word, as the owner gives it; never looked up by Rosie

never_in_a_text: the child's diagnosis, behaviors, health, session data, progress and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the practice's name, the day, the time and the place, and name the child only by first initial
